paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between "Answer Popularity" and three variables: "Accuracy", "Confidence", and "Alignment", for ChatGPT's performance on basketball-related questions. 

The X-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity", has a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 300, with major ticks at intervals of 50. The Y-axis, labeled "Values", is also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 with major ticks at intervals of 0.2.

The graph contains three distinct lines, each representing one of the variables. The "Accuracy" line is depicted in blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 0.3 when "Answer Popularity" is 0, decreases slightly to around 0.2 at a popularity of 50, and then gradually increases to about 0.58 at a popularity of 200 before slightly decreasing to around 0.52 at a popularity of 300.

The "Confidence" line is shown in green with triangular markers and a solid line style. It begins at roughly 0.8 when "Answer Popularity" is 0, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations between 0.8 and 0.85 across the range of "Answer Popularity", and ends at approximately 0.82 at a popularity of 300.

The "Alignment" line is represented in red with square markers and a solid line style. It commences at about 0.55 when "Answer Popularity" is 0, decreases to roughly 0.4 at a popularity of 50, then steadily rises to approximately 0.75 at a popularity of 200, before slightly decreasing to around 0.72 at a popularity of 300.

Overall, the graph provides a visual representation of how "Accuracy", "Confidence", and "Alignment" vary in relation to "Answer Popularity" for ChatGPT on basketball-related queries.
